parameters.command:
=cat << 'EOF' > /tmp/activate_{{ $('Generate Unique Credentials').item.json.sAMAccountName }}.ldif
dn: CN={{ $('Generate Unique Credentials').item.json.displayName }},OU=NewHires,DC=example,DC=com
changetype: modify
replace: unicodePwd
unicodePwd:: {{ $('Generate Unique Credentials').item.json.unicodePwd }}
-
replace: userAccountControl
userAccountControl: 512
-
replace: pwdLastSet
pwdLastSet: -1

dn: CN=Role_StandardUser,OU=Groups,DC=example,DC=com
changetype: modify
add: member
member: CN={{ $('Generate Unique Credentials').item.json.displayName }},OU=NewHires,DC=example,DC=com
EOF
LDAPTLS_REQCERT=never ldapmodify -H ldaps://<YOUR_DC_IP>:636 -x -D "service_account@example.com" -w "<YOUR_LDAP_PASSWORD>" -f /tmp/activate_{{ $('Generate Unique Credentials').item.json.sAMAccountName }}.ldif

parameters.subject: Welcome to the team!
parameters.contentValue:
=

Welcome, {{ $('Generate Unique Credentials').item.json.displayName }}!

Login: {{ $('Generate Unique Credentials').item.json.userPrincipalName }}

Password: {{ $('Generate Unique Credentials').item.json.generatedPassword }}

value.aField: ={{ $json.error_source + ': ' + ($('Create AD Account').item.json.error || $('Email: Welcome Guide').item.json.error || 'Деталі помилки втрачено') }}
